title: Setting up SSO with Okta
content:
## Prerequisites
- CloudDash Pro or Enterprise plan
- Okta administrator access

## Step-by-step setup

### In CloudDash
1. Go to **Settings → SSO**.
2. Click **Configure SAML**.
3. Copy these values — you will need them in Okta:
   - **ACS URL**: `https://app.clouddash.io/auth/saml/callback`
   - **Entity ID**: `https://app.clouddash.io/auth/saml`
   - **Name ID Format**: `EmailAddress`

### In Okta
1. Go to **Applications → Create App Integration**.
2. Choose **SAML 2.0**.
3. Set **Single sign-on URL** to the ACS URL above.
4. Set **Audience URI** to the Entity ID above.
5. Under **Attribute Statements**, add:
   - Name: `email` → Value: `user.email`
   - Name: `name` → Value: `user.displayName`
6. Click **Finish** and go to the **Sign On** tab.
7. Click **View Setup Instructions** and download the **IdP metadata XML**.

### Back in CloudDash
1. Upload the IdP metadata XML under **Settings → SSO → Upload Metadata**.
2. Click **Test SSO**. A new browser tab opens with the Okta login page.
3. Log in with an Okta user. If successful, you see a confirmation screen.
4. Click **Enable SSO** to activate for all users.

## Enforcing SSO
Once enabled, you can optionally enforce SSO so password-based login is disabled for all non-admin users.
